references.text: The five men who were sent to spy out the land are mentioned here for the first time, and these same men go in to take the cult objects.
The ephod, household gods, the carved image, and the cast image are also mentioned here as the same objects taken in verse 17.
Here the origin of the carved image and cast image that the tribe of Dan later stole is described.
The six hundred men armed with weapons of war from the tribe of Dan are mentioned here as the same group standing at the gate.
The priest received the ephod, household gods, and the carved image, showing what happened to the objects mentioned in verse 17.
The ephod as a cult object for seeking God's will is described here, the same type of object that was stolen.
Teraphim (household gods) are mentioned here when Rachel stole them from Laban, the same kind of idol as in Judges 18:17.
